page.layout: Top: running head at top centre, page number at top left. Main block: verses 3 to 6 in italic verse stanzas, verse numbers in the left margin. Below, a rule and the centred heading "PSAL. XI.", then the psalm in verse stanzas with a large drop initial. Catchword at bottom right. Faint show-through on the right edge is ignored.

l.i: IN Domino mihi certa salus: nil omnia vestrûm
Verba moror, qui me fugere, & migrare
monetis. Vt pauidus fugiens passerculus auolat alis.
Ecce sed adductum iam contrahit impius
sagittas, Vt clandestino innocuum transfigat ab
ictu. Ne qua tui vero tibi
Aspice convulso labefactas cardine leges, Fas
versum atque nefas: ideoq; hoc tempore iustos

page.notes: Greek word in verse 4 (Ἀμούσα) is read from the scan and may be inaccurate; check against the page. "fit" in Ps. XI line 6 is doubtful (long s or f). "curnis" in verse 3 is read as printed and may be "cornis". "vestrûm" is read with a tilde over u. Verse lines are run together within each stanza; the printed line breaks are not kept. Verse numbers 3 to 6 stand in the left margin. The stanza "IN Domino..." begins with a large initial I, read as IN. The catchword "Quas" stands at bottom right, below the last line. Right edge shows show-through, not transcribed.
